messages.content: Write solve(x) in one Python code block. The standard library and any explicitly listed optional callables are available.

x is CSV text with header label,value, in arrival order. Labels are short words and readings are signed integers from -7 to 7. Write solve(x). Return a dictionary that will map each observed label to its largest reading minus its smallest reading. Empty input gives an empty dictionary. For example x = 'label,value
ivy,4
oak,-1
ivy,1
oak,-1
ivy,1
' gives {'ivy': 3, 'oak': 0}.
